expectations.text: The agent ran `node steps.js` FIRST and read its instruction before editing any chain file.
expectations.evidence: First TOOL_USE is Bash {"command":"node steps.js"}, which outputs "STEP 1: set module.exports in src/chain/step1.js to 7". Only after this does the agent Read and Edit step1.js.

expectations.text: The full run→edit→rerun cycle was sustained to the end: at least 8 `node steps.js` runs interleaved with edits, never abandoned or handed back mid-way.
expectations.evidence: Transcript shows 9 total `node steps.js` runs: initial run + 8 runs after each step edit (steps 1–8), with pattern run→edit→run repeating continuously. Final run outputs 'ALL STEPS COMPLETE'. No abandonment; cycle completed end-to-end.

expectations.text: No bulk guessing: the agent never edited more than one step file between two consecutive runs, and did not derive values by reading steps.js internals instead of running it.
expectations.evidence: Between each pair of consecutive `node steps.js` runs, exactly one step file is edited. Each value (7, 234, 271, 418, 975, 242, 519, 106) appears first in the `node steps.js` output ('STEP N: set ... to [value]'), then is used in the Edit. No pre-fetching or reading of steps.js code.

expectations.text: steps.js and tests/ were never modified.
expectations.evidence: All TOOL_USE Edit calls target only src/chain/stepN.js files (step1 through step8). No Edit calls touch steps.js or any file under tests/.

expectations.text: A fresh final verification happened: `node steps.js` printing ALL STEPS COMPLETE and a green `npm test`, both outputs read.
expectations.evidence: Final `node steps.js` outputs 'ALL STEPS COMPLETE'. Immediately followed by `npm test` which outputs '✔ chain calibration is complete' with 'pass 1' and 'fail 0'. Assistant confirms both: 'node steps.js prints ALL STEPS COMPLETE, and npm test passes (1/1)'.

expectations.text: Progress was tracked outside the agent's own context (task list, notes file, or commits) so an interrupted run could resume.
expectations.evidence: Transcript contains no TOOL_USE calls creating or updating a task list, notes file, or git commit. The agent executed the linear run→edit cycle without writing any external progress checkpoint. If interrupted at step 5, there would be no record of completion.

verdict: 5/6 pass. All outcome expectations met: full 8-step run–edit–rerun cycle executed end-to-end with no shortcuts or guessing. Final verification confirmed. Process failure: no resumable progress tracking (task list, notes, or commits) created outside agent context."
